short_title: Technical Assistance for Health Grants Act

summary.text:
Technical Assistance for Health Grants Act

This bill provides funding for, and changes the scope and purpose of, technical assistance provided under the Health Profession Opportunity Grants (HPOG) program. (The HPOG program is administered by the Administration for Children and Families and it provides education and training to low-income individuals for in-demand occupations in the health care field.)
